description: Real VS Code heartbeats from the v1 per-file throttle era (2026-04), snapshotted so the config-invariance claim can be tested by downsampling REAL bursty activity rather than synthetic evenly-spaced heartbeats.
note: The file path (`name`) and `os` are omitted: they are irrelevant to a total-duration test and dominate the file size. `duration` is kept so the era-dependent direction of the legacy field's error stays testable offline.
